label: copy-phase input b, early-middle recall positions
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the input is b (99.8% of activation mass is on in_tok b), i.e. the step right after the model has output b and fed it back. It never fires in the original phase or on <DEL>. It is nearly silent when b was original token 0 (recall_idx 1) and weak at late recall positions (6+); the mass is concentrated at recall_idx 2-5 and peaks at recall_idx 3 (about 49% of mass, 62% firing rate). The strongest activations are b at original positions 1-2, often followed by 0 (e.g. a b 0 x), but a next-token-is-digit condition does not raise precision. Precision is the limitation: even within recall_idx 2-5 only about 40% of b inputs fire, and length, next output, token count and absolute t do not explain which ones do. Activations on non-b inputs are rare and tiny.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: b, 0, f, z, d, h; least: y, k, r, p) and the token being output (most: 0, z, f, b, q, c; least: k, v, t, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=3 & t=5, L=4 & t=6.
